scenarios.environment: npm-packed Sand-King; npm-pinned real Chromium; locally bundled @xterm emulator and fit addon; deterministic conformance provider in a runtime-owned PTY; real Controller runtime and local Host

actions: render the production three-region Workbench at 1440×1000 and exercise both narrow drawers without horizontal page overflow
interpret split ANSI/VT cursor, erase, colour, alternate-screen, and redraw output into the intended final screen
send printable, Enter, Tab, Escape, arrow, navigation, deletion, and control-key data exactly once
fit and resize the provider PTY initially and after meaningful container changes
reject invalid dimensions, stale sequences, wrong correlations, read-only input, and a competing writer
reconnect to the same runtime-owned Controller with bounded retained-output resynchronization
acknowledge an attachment before ordered replay and live output without duplicate sequences
scenarios.expectedTypedOutcome: interactive Workbench Controller terminal with accepted correlated resize acknowledgements and typed prohibited outcomes
canonicalStateInvariants: terminal bytes remain opaque and are never parsed as product state
the Controller runtime owns the PTY and exactly one attachment may write or resize
browser detachment does not terminate the provider
attachment acknowledgement establishes the output cursor before replay and live delivery
resizing is correlated by Controller session, stream, attachment, and monotonic sequence
terminal input and resize audits retain byte counts and dimensions but no contents
existing Project, Planning, Launch request, Harness run, diagnostics, failure, and reconnect state remains truthful
prohibitedSideEffects: stale or mismatched resize affecting a Controller session
prototype route, variant switcher, or fake product state
sudo, system package install, shell profile mutation, or service configuration
